configuration.purpose: The cache is deliberately limited to Qwen's one-token top-8 expert width. Cross-layer and cross-token residency is continuously evicted, and multi-token prefill working sets are split into exact groups. This is a correctness stress configuration, not a performance candidate.

workload.output_text: This sequence juxtapes programming syntax, multilingual text, emojis, JSON data,
workload.content: Heterogeneous Python syntax, Japanese, Arabic, emoji, JSON, algebra, repeated tokens, and an exact identifier

decision.status: Forced minimum-capacity churn correctness gate passed
decision.reason: Despite a 66.9% stable-store miss rate, 43.2 GB of demand reads, no prefetch, continuous global eviction, and exact working-set splitting during prefill, every full-vocabulary generated-step logit vector and every output token matched the Python exact-expert reference. Swap occupancy did not grow.
decision.quality_scope: This validates exact execution under an intentionally hostile cache policy for this heterogeneous trace. It does not prove all possible route traces or compare 4-bit model quality with BF16.
